stages.purpose: Validate the public orchestration contract and prove its role graph without biological inputs.

tool_container_version_evidence.evidence: Repository smoke validator and focused tests

validation_contract: The schema, ordered stages, role graph, privacy boundary, and repository entrypoints must validate.
The synthetic run creates role markers only and never reads biological data.
fail_closed_conditions: Reject unknown fields, duplicate keys, missing roles, disconnected stages, or unsafe paths.
Reject a contract whose public entrypoint resolves outside the repository.
stages.scalability_notes: Constant-size metadata validation; independent of protected input volume.

stages.purpose: Pair protected read inputs under generic internal roles and produce a sealed transfer manifest.

tool_container_version_evidence.evidence: Repository implementation and secure WGS regression tests

validation_contract: Inputs must form complete read pairs and remain outside the public repository.
The manifest uses generic roles and records integrity digests without public source names.
fail_closed_conditions: Stop on incomplete pairs, unsupported metadata, missing approval, unsafe destinations, or absent integrity evidence.
Never emit source names, credentials, or protected paths to public output.
stages.scalability_notes: Metadata and digest work scales linearly with file count; protected bytes are not copied into the repository.

stages.purpose: Resolve a short-lived private transfer plan into verified generic inputs inside an approved execution boundary.

tool_container_version_evidence.evidence: Repository implementation with expiry, redirect, path, and digest checks

validation_contract: The transfer plan must be signed, unexpired, integrity-pinned, and stored outside the repository.
Downloaded objects must match the manifest roles and expected digests.
fail_closed_conditions: Stop on expired plans, unsafe redirects, unexpected names, digest mismatch, symlinks, or existing destinations.
Do not print transfer material or response bodies.
stages.scalability_notes: Transfers stream per object and can use provider-side concurrency only after integrity and cost controls are approved.

stages.purpose: Perform accelerated alignment and short-variant calling in a pinned, approved containerized environment.

tool_container_version_evidence.container: digest must be supplied from an independently reviewed manifest
tool_container_version_evidence.evidence: Public runner pins the release and fails until an approved digest is installed

tool_container_version_evidence.container: shipped with the approved Parabricks image
tool_container_version_evidence.evidence: Compatibility is documented in the secure WGS method inventory

validation_contract: The operator must independently pin the container digest, reference identity, input manifest, and runtime approvals.
The runner must record generic quality and integrity receipts while protected outputs remain private.
fail_closed_conditions: Stop when approval flags, image digest, reference identity, input integrity, runtime tools, or minimum compute checks fail.
Stop rather than downgrade to an unpinned image or unapproved execution host.
stages.scalability_notes: The accepted baseline is one high-memory accelerator with parallel host processing and fast ephemeral storage; cohort scaling is one isolated run per sample or a reviewed batch scheduler.

stages.purpose: Combine complementary variant classes with phenotype-aware prioritization under pinned scientific methods.

tool_container_version_evidence.evidence: Versions and interpretation boundaries are documented in the secure WGS method inventory
Versions and analysis boundaries are documented in the secure WGS method inventory
Versions and interpretation boundaries are documented in the secure WGS method inventory

stages.public_entrypoint_reason: The accepted analysis combines several licensed, externally distributed, or heavyweight tools and protected evidence; no single sanitized end-to-end runner is present in this repository.
validation_contract: Each lane must retain its pinned version, reference resources, parameters, and privacy-safe receipt.
Cross-caller agreement is technical corroboration, not independent biological confirmation.
fail_closed_conditions: Do not substitute unavailable tools silently or merge incompatible representations.
Do not elevate a ranking or caller score into a clinical conclusion without human evidence review.
stages.scalability_notes: Independent lanes can run in parallel after the primary evidence is available; each lane remains separately pinned, resource-budgeted, and receipt-bound.

stages.purpose: Run an aggregate research screen from depth and frequency evidence without exporting per-site records.

tool_container_version_evidence.container: none for the analyzer; pinned external tools for input preparation
tool_container_version_evidence.evidence: Synthetic regression tests cover neutral, signal, threshold, privacy, and fail-closed behavior
Companion runner enforces versions and writes aggregate output only

validation_contract: The analyzer accepts only prepared aggregate-compatible roles inside the secure boundary.
Public evidence is limited to synthetic tests and privacy-safe aggregate receipts.
fail_closed_conditions: Stop on malformed inputs, inconsistent contigs, missing controls, nonfinite values, unsafe paths, or threshold violations.
Never export per-site evidence from the protected execution boundary.
stages.scalability_notes: Preparation is parallelizable by chromosome; deterministic aggregation uses bounded summaries rather than retaining site-level public data.

stages.purpose: Reconcile caller evidence, phenotype rankings, and research screens under a human-controlled scientific release policy.

tool_container_version_evidence.evidence: Privacy-safe evidence receipts and frozen scientific review boundaries

stages.public_entrypoint_reason: This step requires protected evidence inspection and accountable human judgment; publishing an automated replacement would overstate reproducibility and clinical certainty.
validation_contract: Every retained statement must trace to a pinned lane receipt and the scientific cutoff.
Human review must preserve uncertainty, confirmation requirements, and non-diagnostic language.
fail_closed_conditions: Stop when evidence lineage, scientific cutoff, privacy review, or human approval is absent.
Do not infer missing phase, segregation, mechanism, or clinical confirmation.
stages.scalability_notes: Automated aggregation reduces review volume, but accountable evidence reconciliation remains a bounded human bottleneck by design.

stages.purpose: Validate the Track 1 CSV structure and organizer-facing constraints before any upload.

tool_container_version_evidence.evidence: Repository implementation and public validation tests

validation_contract: The CSV schema, row semantics, grouping, identifiers, and size constraints must pass the public validator.
Validation proves format compliance only; it does not re-evaluate protected scientific evidence.
fail_closed_conditions: Reject malformed, unexpected, privacy-unsafe, or policy-inconsistent submission content.
Validation never uploads or submits the file.
stages.scalability_notes: Streaming-sized local validation is negligible compared with WGS analysis and is suitable for repeated pre-submission checks.

stages.purpose: Verify that controlled paths and external compute resources are absent after authorized cleanup.

tool_container_version_evidence.evidence: Repository implementation is non-destructive and passes only when all declared resources are absent

validation_contract: All declared controlled paths and compute resources must be absent before a passing receipt is written.
The receipt remains private and contains no credentials or protected data.
fail_closed_conditions: Return failure if any path or external resource remains, status is ambiguous, or the private receipt destination is unsafe.
The verifier never deletes resources and never treats an API error as proof of absence.
stages.scalability_notes: Verification cost scales with the small declared resource inventory, not with WGS byte volume.
